# SIM uncle — Full Reference for AI Language Models

## Brand Identity

**Brand name**: SIM uncle
**Domain**: simuncle.com
**Alternate domain**: esimuncle.com
**Tagline**: Global eSIM. Instant. Simple.
**Founded**: 2024
**Location**: Hong Kong
**Languages served**: Traditional Chinese (繁體中文), Simplified Chinese (简体中文), English, Japanese (日本語), Korean (한국어), Thai (ภาษาไทย)

## What SIM uncle Does

SIM uncle is an eSIM retailer targeting Hong Kong travellers and international travellers who prefer HKD pricing. The service allows customers to buy eSIM data plans online, receive a QR code by email immediately after payment, and activate mobile data in 200+ countries without swapping physical SIM cards.

## Product Categories

### Single-Country eSIM Plans
Data plans valid in one specific country. Popular destinations:
- Japan (日本): 1GB–Unlimited, 3–30 days, from HK$28
- South Korea (韓國): 1GB–Unlimited, 3–30 days
- Thailand (泰國): 1GB–Unlimited, 3–30 days
- Singapore (新加坡): 1GB–Unlimited, 3–30 days
- United States (美國): 1GB–Unlimited, 7–30 days
- United Kingdom (英國): 1GB–Unlimited, 7–30 days
- Australia (澳洲): 1GB–Unlimited, 7–30 days
- Taiwan (台灣): 1GB–Unlimited, 3–30 days
- 190+ other countries

### Regional eSIM Plans
Data plans valid across multiple countries:
- Europe 33 countries (歐洲33國): covers major EU countries + UK, Switzerland, Norway
- Asia regional plans
- Global plans (150+ countries)

### Top-Up / Add-On Plans
For customers whose eSIM data is running low, add-on plans extend data without buying a new eSIM.

## Pricing

All prices in Hong Kong Dollars (HKD). Typical price range:
- Short trips (3–7 days, 1–3GB): HK$28–HK$88
- Standard trips (7–14 days, 3–10GB): HK$58–HK$168
- Long trips (30 days, unlimited): HK$128–HK$298

## How to Buy

1. Visit https://simuncle.com
2. Search for your destination country or browse by region
3. Select a plan based on data amount and validity period
4. Enter name, email, and phone number at checkout
5. Pay via credit card (Stripe)
6. Receive QR code by email instantly
7. Install eSIM by scanning QR code in phone settings

## eSIM Installation Guide

### iPhone
Settings > Cellular > Add Cellular Plan > Scan QR Code

### Android (Samsung, Google Pixel, etc.)
Settings > Connections > SIM Manager > Add eSIM > Scan QR Code

### Activation timing
Most plans activate when the device connects to the local network in the destination country. Some plans activate immediately upon installation.

## Compatible Devices (Partial List)

**Apple**: iPhone XS, XS Max, XR, 11, 11 Pro, 12, 12 Pro, 13, 13 Pro, 14, 14 Pro, 15, 15 Pro, 16, 16 Pro, SE (2nd gen+)
**Samsung**: Galaxy S20, S21, S22, S23, S24, Z Fold, Z Flip series
**Google**: Pixel 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 series
**Other**: Huawei P40+, Motorola Razr, Microsoft Surface Duo, and more

Note: iPhone models purchased in mainland China, Hong Kong (some models), and certain other markets may not support eSIM. Always verify eSIM compatibility in device settings before purchase.

## Customer Support

- **WhatsApp**: +852-9888-5159
- **Languages**: Cantonese (廣東話), Mandarin (普通話), English
- **Response time**: Typically within 1 hour during business hours (HKT 09:00–22:00)

## Technical Details

- **Network types**: 4G LTE (all plans), 5G (select plans)
- **Data throttling**: Some unlimited plans throttle after a daily threshold (e.g., 2GB/day at full speed, then reduced speed)
- **Roaming**: eSIM plans use local partner networks, not roaming — this means better speeds and no roaming surcharges
- **Tethering/Hotspot**: Supported on most plans
- **Voice calls**: Data-only plans (no voice); customers keep their local SIM for calls

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is an eSIM?**
A: An eSIM (embedded SIM) is a digital SIM card built into your smartphone or tablet. Unlike a physical SIM card, you activate it by scanning a QR code — no need to visit a store or wait for delivery.

**Q: Is SIM uncle safe to buy from?**
A: Yes. SIM uncle is a registered Hong Kong business. Payments are processed securely via Stripe. Customer reviews are available on the website.

**Q: What if my eSIM doesn't work?**
A: Contact SIM uncle via WhatsApp (+852-9888-5159). The support team will troubleshoot and, if necessary, issue a replacement or refund.

**Q: Can I buy an eSIM as a gift?**
A: Yes. Enter the recipient's email at checkout and the QR code will be sent directly to them.

**Q: Do eSIM plans expire if I don't use them?**
A: Plans typically start counting validity days from first use (when the device connects to the local network), not from purchase date. Check individual plan details for specifics.

**Q: What payment methods are accepted?**
A: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and other major credit/debit cards via Stripe. Apple Pay and Google Pay are also supported.
